description: The provided file 'utils.php' is a core utility script for SuiteCRM, containing functions for configuration management, language loading, user handling, and system utilities. It includes global configuration functions, language string loaders, user info functions, and system utility helpers.

classes.name: Localization
classes.description: A class managing locale-specific configuration defaults, used for merging language and locale settings.

classes.name: LanguageManager
classes.description: Provides methods for loading and caching language files related to modules and application strings.

classes.name: SugarThemeRegistry
classes.description: Manages theme-related resources and paths, particularly for theme language files.

methods.name: uuid_create
methods.description: Generates a new UUID v4 string using the symfony/polyfill-uuid library.

methods.name: sugar_cache_retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value associated with a specific key.

methods.name: sugar_cache_put
methods.description: Stores a value in cache under the specified key.

methods.name: write_array_to_file
methods.description: Serializes and writes an array to a PHP file for configuration or cache.

methods.name: sugarLangArrayMerge
methods.description: Merges language arrays, favoring later values, used for combining language strings.

methods.name: sugarArrayMerge
methods.description: Recursively merges multiple arrays, similar to array_merge but for nested arrays.

methods.name: sugarArrayMergeRecursive
methods.description: Performs recursive merge of arrays, similar to array_merge_recursive with custom behavior.

methods.name: get_user_array
methods.description: Returns an array of user IDs and display names based on filters, with support for caching.

methods.name: getUserArrayFromFullName
methods.description: Returns a list of users matching name search criteria, with optional portal user filtering.

methods.name: showFullName
methods.description: Determines whether to display user's full name based on preferences.

methods.name: get_authenticated_user
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated User object or null if not available.

methods.name: is_guid
methods.description: Checks if a string matches the pattern of a GUID.

methods.name: create_guid
methods.description: Creates a new RFC 4122 UUID V4 string.

methods.name: microtime_diff
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two microtime strings.

methods.name: displayStudioForCurrentUser
methods.description: Determines if the current user has Studio access (always returns true).

methods.name: addCronAllowedUser
methods.description: Adds a user to the allowed cron users list in configuration, for Linux systems.
